description: Canonical fixed-workload contract for all baseline and optimized 512-game CUDA neural self-play measurements.

seeds.game_seed_derivation: python-random.Random(batch_seed).getrandbits(64), once per game in zero-based game-index order
seeds.decision_seed_derivation: canonical run_match per-ply derivation from each game seed

output.timing_scope: End-to-end wall time from immediately before self-play dispatch until all 512 per-game artifacts and summary.json have been durably written; checkpoint load and one-time process setup are reported separately and excluded.

required_artifacts.games: Exactly 512 versioned twixt-ai match JSON artifacts at games/game-NNNNNN.json, one for every zero-based game index, with complete move history and per-decision MCTS metadata including root visits.
required_artifacts.summary: One version 1 twixt-ai-selfplay-batch summary.json manifest reporting games=512, completed=512, failed=0, every derived game seed, artifact path, outcome, move count, and aggregate totals.

target_semantics.policy: For every recorded position, the sparse policy target is the legal root-move visit distribution: each probability is visits / 4 and the probabilities sum to 1.
target_semantics.value: The terminal game result from the recorded position's side-to-move perspective: win=1, draw=0, loss=-1.
target_semantics.primary_performance_target: Minimize the required end-to-end wall time without changing any contract field or required output.

invariants.single_source_of_truth: Every baseline, profiling, optimization, regression, and final benchmark run must match this artifact exactly.
invariants.no_workload_weakening: The game count is fixed at 512. No board, rules, checkpoint, encoding, search, seed, worker, batching, output, or target parameter may be reduced, relaxed, substituted, skipped, or reinterpreted to manufacture a speedup.
invariants.allowed_changes: Only implementation changes that preserve this exact workload and its output/target semantics may be compared. Environment and profiling metadata may be added to a run report but do not override this contract.
